name: Second-order structure and the Little Professor
oneLine: The Child ego-state has its own internal Parent-Adult-Child (P1, A1, C1); A1 - Berne's own term was simply "the Professor", popularized as the "Little Professor" - is the child's intuitive, strategic thinking, not just feeling.
whatYouDid: You read Mike's calm, timed, unverifiable claim about what Mom supposedly said and had to recognize it as thinking - fast, intuitive, strategic - rather than either a feeling outburst or a lie needing a moral verdict.
confusion: People treat the Child ego-state as pure feeling and leave the thinking to Adult and Parent; the tell is Berne's own second-order model, which puts a working intuitive intelligence (A1) right inside the Child, developing from infancy and capable of real strategy long before anything we'd call grown-up reasoning.

fromBook.quote: I relied more on intuition, instant impressions.

expand.definition: In the second-order structural model, the Child ego-state (C2) contains its own Parent (P1, the "Magical Parent", Berne's "Electrode"), Adult (A1, Berne's "the Professor", popularly the "Little Professor") and Child (C1, the "Somatic Child"); A1 is the child's fast, intuitive, pre-logical problem-solving capacity.
expand.otherFraming: Berne himself used simply "the Professor" in his original writing; "Little Professor" is the popularized label that stuck, including in accounts of games forming between parents and young children.
expand.tryThisToday: Next time a child (or your own Child) tries something clever rather than just reacting, name it to yourself as thinking, not just feeling - and ask what hypothesis it's actually testing.
